description: A PHP class named ImportFileSplitter that handles splitting large CSV files into smaller parts, including methods for file existence check, splitting, and retrieving split file info.

classes.name: ImportFileSplitter
classes.description: Class to handle splitting a CSV file into multiple parts, managing file counts, record counts, and file splitting logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the splitter with source filename and record threshold, sanitizing input.

methods.name: fileExists
methods.description: Checks if the source file exists and is readable.

methods.name: splitSourceFile
methods.description: Splits the source CSV file into multiple smaller files based on record threshold.

methods.name: getRecordCount
methods.description: Returns total number of records in the source file after splitting.

methods.name: getFileCount
methods.description: Returns number of split files created.

methods.name: getSplitFileName
methods.description: Returns filename of a specific split file by number.
